title: Create does nothing, with no message, while an earlier box's import is still pending
trigger: Window > Add Contact, Create, close the box before the answer, reopen it and press Create again.
effect: add_contact_by_phone returns Ok(None) because UsersState::new_contact_request is session-wide and still set; submit_new_contact then changes nothing (sent_request stays None), so the button looks dead, and the first import's answer is dropped for the new box.
fix: Show a pending state for the in-flight import (or cancel/supersede it) instead of Ok(None).

title: Closing side column keeps the previous account's panel target after an account switch
trigger: Open a user's info panel, switch accounts from the account list.
effect: FrameState::panels is app-wide, so last still holds InfoPanelTarget of the old account; for the slide-out frames the column draws that target against the new account's session (wrong or empty user card for about 200 ms).
fix: Reset the reveal in the OnScreen swap (put PanelReveal in OnScreen, or settle to default on account change).

title: Color box shows a shared profile-edit error and keeps its own stale one
trigger: Fail an Apply (or fail another profile edit such as username/photo while the box is open), then pick another swatch.
effect: The box reads the session-wide users_state.profile_edit_error, also written by profile, photo and username saves, so a foreign error shows in the color box; after its own failure the error stays through further edits (edit_peer_color clears only sent) until the next Apply.
fix: Keep the apply failure in the dialog's own stage enum, keyed by the request that asked, and clear it on edit.

title: Business hours expanded and time-zone choice are one global flag pair, not per profile
trigger: Open a business profile, expand its hours and switch to the business time zone, then open another business profile (or the same panel for another user).
effect: The second profile's hours row opens already expanded and in the first person's chosen zone; nothing resets the pair when the profile changes (only written in profile_business.rs, never reset).
fix: Key the state by user id (Option<(UserId, HoursView)>) or hold it in the profile panel owner that is replaced when the target changes.

title: Reaction fly-up animation starts before the request and stays when the request fails
trigger: Add a reaction while offline or when toggle_reaction_choice returns Err
effect: The emoji flies up from the message though no reaction was added
fix: Set reaction_fly only on Ok from the driver call.

title: A failed source listing leaves for_call set with no chooser
trigger: In a call press share screen when listing sources fails (e.g. the backend errors).
effect: for_call stays Some(..) while window is None and sources empty (the empty-list arm clears it, the error arm does not); stop_screen_source/accept_screen_source then act on a chooser that is not open until the call ends.
fix: Move the reset into one Chooser::Closed transition used by the error and empty arms.

title: Self-destruct tick task is guarded by an Option<ChatId> started flag; A -> B -> A within a second runs two tasks
trigger: Open a secret chat with a live self-destruct timer, switch to another chat with a timer and back within one second.
effect: tick_chat is A again so ensure_self_destruct_tick spawns a second task for A while the first (still sleeping) sees still_open and keeps going: two tasks notify every second until the timers end.
fix: Hold the task itself in the owner (Option<(ChatId, Task)>) so replacing it drops the old one.

title: The 15 ms drag poll never checks that a button is still down
trigger: Press on a row, release the button where no mouse-up reaches the window (another window grabbed it), move the pointer back
effect: selection_drag stays Some, the loop keeps polling and extends the range/autoscrolls with no button held, until the next click
fix: Stop the loop when window.pressed_button is None.

title: Report and Save-as-HTML end the selection with clear_forward, which toasts 'Forward cancelled'
trigger: Select a message, click Report N (or Save as HTML)
effect: A 'Forward cancelled' note appears although nothing was forwarded
fix: Split ending a selection (no toast) from cancelling a forward; ForwardStage transition without the note.

title: begin_vanish starts the delete effect before delete_selected is known to succeed
trigger: Delete messages when delete_selected returns Err (or the server refuses)
effect: The messages play the vanish animation and hide although they were not deleted
fix: Start the vanish effect when the deletion update arrives, not at the click.

title: The send-button morph lives in composer_ui, not ChatUi, so switching chats fades from the previous chat's button state
trigger: chat A shows Send (text typed), click chat B whose composer is empty (Record)
effect: a 120 ms cross-fade from A's glyph to B's runs on first draw (and requests animation ticks) although B's button never changed
fix: Key the SendMorph by chat (put it in ChatUi, replaced on chat change) so a new chat starts settled.

title: The send menu stays open (hidden) when the chat changes without a click, and reappears on return
trigger: Right-click Send in chat A, then switch to chat B with a keyboard shortcut or the quick switcher while the pointer still rests over the strip. send_menu_dismissed keeps the menu when the mouse is over a picker part; send_menu_overlay then draws nothing because viewed_chat != open.chat, but composer_ui.send_menu.open stays Some(chat A). Return to chat A.
effect: The old menu (and effect card) pops back up in chat A with a stale state; meanwhile its kit PopupMenu entity and subscriptions are held. Nothing closes the menu on a chat change.
fix: Close the send menu in the chat-change reset (sync_chat_ui / a Farewell of the composer), or make the stage a ChatUi field so it is replaced with the chat.

title: After the effect card fades out the strip's hover animation stays paused until the menu closes
trigger: Right-click Send, pick an effect (card shows), click the card to hide it, hover another strip cell.
effect: preview stays Some with hiding set after it faded (it is never cleared), so paused = open.preview.is_some() is true and hovered cells only show their first frame.
fix: Clear open.preview when it has faded (or compute paused from hiding.is_none()), i.e. make the card stage an enum with a Gone variant.

title: A sticker flight armed in a chat window that closes before it lands is never ended and the sent sticker stays hidden
trigger: Send a sticker from a chat window's panel and close that window within about 2 seconds, then open the same chat in the main window.
effect: FLY (a thread-local, not owned by the window) keeps window=Some(chat). send_fly_overlay returns None in every other window and only the owning window's overlay clears FLY, so wrap() keeps replacing the matching outgoing sticker with an empty placeholder in the main window until another sticker is sent or the app restarts.
fix: Own the flight in the WindowSlot (or end it from the window's Farewell); at least clear FLY when the window it names closes.

title: Reply-in-another-chat box and forward share box can be open together over one search field and one selection
trigger: With a reply set and reply_elsewhere_open true, start a forward from a selection (open_forward_picker never clears reply_elsewhere_open, while open_reply_elsewhere does close the forward picker). sync_share_search accepts either flag.
effect: Two boxes share one search_input, selection and focus_search flag; a tick in one shows in the other and the second box can take focus away.
fix: One enum ShareChooser { None, Forward(..), ReplyElsewhere } so only one chooser exists and opening one replaces the other.

title: Kit dialog can be closed twice in a transition, closing an unrelated top dialog
trigger: An action clears a dialog flag and calls close_kit_dialog_if_done (window.close_dialog), while the shell still has open_dialog = Some(old). The next sync sees open_dialog != first_open and calls window.close_dialog again before opening the next box.
effect: If another kit dialog (an alert opened with open_alert_dialog) is on top by then, it is closed instead of nothing.
fix: close_kit_dialog_if_done should also clear shell.open_dialog, or the sync should check the kit layer has a dialog before closing.

title: A story viewer open in the main window blocks the history shortcuts of every chat window
trigger: Open a story in the main window, then press PageUp, Cmd+Up, Delete on a selection or Ctrl+Space in a chat window. shortcut_blocked reads self.stories.viewer.is_open(), which is the main window's, while self.viewer.state is the window's own.
effect: The shortcuts do nothing in the chat window until the story closes.
fix: Block on this window's own viewer only; the story viewer blocks only when the scope is the main window.

title: Report option picker stays after a pick, so a second click sends the report twice
trigger: In the sponsored report picker click an option, then click again before the reportSponsoredResult answer arrives.
effect: Two reportChatSponsoredMessage requests; second may fail with an error note after the first 'Report sent'.
fix: SponsoredReportFlight becomes Picking{options} | Sending{option} | Done and the panel disables on Sending.

title: Parsed-chart cache is keyed by buffer address and length with a 3x128 byte sample, so a reused address can return a stale chart
trigger: A statistics refresh frees the old JSON string and the new one of the same length is allocated at the same address with equal first/middle/last 128 bytes but different values elsewhere.
effect: The old chart is drawn for the new data until the cache is cleared at 64 entries.
fix: Key by a hash of the full JSON, or hold Rc<StatChart> in the state next to the graph.

title: Tab reveal key has no chat id, so another chat's strip is not scrolled to its selected tab
trigger: Open a forum chat with the strip scrolled to topic index k, switch to another chat whose selected tab has the same index, tab count and strip width (or the same chat after the key matches an old one).
effect: needs_reveal compares only (selected, tab_count, strip_width) against the last key held in HistoryUi, which is not reset on a chat change; the strip keeps the previous chat's scroll offset and the selected tab can sit out of view.
fix: Add the chat id (AccountChat owner key) to RevealKey, or reset SubsectionTabsScroll in sync_chat_ui.

title: Per-window toast Presence entries are never removed
trigger: Open and close many chat windows over a session.
effect: Surfaces::toasts is a HashMap<Option<i64>, Presence<StatusNote>> filled by status_toast_in (entry per host) and never pruned when a chat window closes; each retains its last StatusNote text.
fix: Remove the entry in the window-close path (ToastQueue::window_closed caller).

title: A password typed in the Privacy page check card is never cleared when the user leaves
trigger: Privacy page shows the 'Your password' card; type a password without pressing Check, leave the page or close Settings.
effect: close_twofa clears status_check_password but nothing clears check_password (only submit does), so the masked text stays in the field and is back in the card next time the page opens, until an account switch replaces the screen.
fix: Clear check_password in the Privacy page's leave hook (and on close of Settings), as close_twofa does for the box's fields.

title: Dust starts from where a row was last painted, which can be stale or off screen
trigger: Select several messages, scroll so some are out of view (or select some, scroll away and back elsewhere), then Delete.
effect: PAINTED keeps each row's last painted bounds until 4096 entries pile up, and begin_vanish uses them as they are. A selected row painted at another scroll offset makes its dust appear over other rows at the old position.
fix: Record the frame or scroll generation with each painted bound and use it only when it is from the current frame of that window, else crumble without dust.

title: A delete that never lands keeps a 60 fps redraw running for 10 seconds
trigger: Delete a message the server refuses to delete (for example an old message in a group without the right), or delete the only message left in a chat.
effect: begin_vanish pushes a Waiting ghost. merge_vanishing starts it only when a non-empty message list for its chat lacks the id: a refused delete keeps the message, and an emptied chat has messages.first() == None. Until VANISH_WAIT (10 s) prunes it, vanish_overlay sees a non-empty list and calls request_animation_tick(60) every frame, so the window redraws at 60 fps for 10 s with nothing animating. A deleted last message also gets no dust.
fix: Tick only for started ghosts. A Waiting ghost needs no frames, so wake it with the deletion update or a timer at VANISH_WAIT. Start the ghost from the deletion update (keyed by chat and message) rather than from the rows' absence.
